# SpikeBackpropagation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A training technique that propagates errors through spiking neural networks using surrogate gradients to overcome the non-differentiability of spike events. Provides a practical pathway for implementing learning-capable neuromorphic circuits within network infrastructure, supporting adaptive in-network computation.
